{"target":"ssh","id":"15","path":"/tmp/nxr/drv.sh","content":"#!/bin/sh
# Isolated Runner resume-test driver.
# The Runner token is loaded ONLY inside this process from the 0600 env file.
# It is never echoed, never placed on the command line, and never written to output.
set -eu
umask 077

ENVF=/opt/nexus-agent-runner-test/etc/runner.env
. "$ENVF"

: "${NEXUS_AGENT_RUNNER_TOKEN:[REDACTED] token}"
: "${PORT:?missing port}"
HOST="${NEXUS_AGENT_RUNNER_HOST:-127.0.0.1}"
BASE="http://${HOST}:${PORT}"
PROTO="2026-09-13"
WS="resume-ws-42"
BODY=/tmp/nxr/.body.$$
trap 'rm -f "$BODY"' EXIT

api() { # method path [json]
  m="$1"; p="$2"
  if [ "$#" -ge 3 ]; then
    code=$(curl -sS -o "$BODY" -w '%{http_code}' -X "$m" "${BASE}${p}" \
      -H "Authorization: Bearer ${NEXUS_AGENT_RUNNER_TOKEN}" \
      -H "x-nexus-agent-protocol: ${PROTO}" \
      -H 'content-type: application/json' --data "$3")
  else
    code=$(curl -sS -o "$BODY" -w '%{http_code}' -X "$m" "${BASE}${p}" \
      -H "Authorization: Bearer ${NEXUS_AGENT_RUNNER_TOKEN}" \
      -H "x-nexus-agent-protocol: ${PROTO}")
  fi
  echo "HTTP ${code} ${m} ${p}"
  json_get status
  return 0
}

json_get() { # print one top-level-ish field value from body (string/number)
  sed -n "s/.*\"$1\":\([^,}]*\).*/\1/p" "$BODY" | head -1 | tr -d '\n'
  echo
}

raw() { cat "$BODY"; echo; }

poll_command() { # commandId
  i=0
  while [ "$i" -lt 120 ]; do
    api GET "/v1/commands/$1" >/dev/null
    st=$(sed -n 's/.*"status":"\([a-z]*\)".*/\1/p' "$BODY" | head -1)
    case "$st" in
      succeeded|failed|cancelled|unknown) echo "command $1 terminal status=$st"; raw; return 0 ;;
    esac
    i=$((i+1)); sleep 0.4
  done
  echo "command $1 did not reach terminal state"; raw; return 1
}

now_deadline() { echo $(( $(date +%s) + 900 )); }

cmd "$@" 2>/dev/null || true

case "${1:-}" in
  provision)
    D=$(now_deadline)
    api POST /v1/commands "{\"commandId\":\"resume-cmd-prov-1\",\"workspaceId\":\"$WS\",\"generation\":1,\"action\":\"provision\",\"deadlineAt\":$D,\"recipeId\":\"workspace-dev\",\"recipeRevision\":\"2\",\"runtimeDigest\":\"nexus-agent-runner:workspace-toolchain-profile-v2\",\"catalogRevision\":\"2026-09-30.2\",\"toolchain\":[{\"familyId\":\"base-tools\",\"versionId\":\"1\"}],\"runnerPlugins\":[],\"acpProfiles\":[],\"browserTarget\":null,\"retained\":false}"
    poll_command resume-cmd-prov-1
    ;;
  start)
    D=$(now_deadline)
    api POST /v1/commands "{\"commandId\":\"resume-cmd-start-1\",\"workspaceId\":\"$WS\",\"generation\":1,\"action\":\"start\",\"deadlineAt\":$D}"
    poll_command resume-cmd-start-1
    ;;
  status)
    api GET "/v1/workspaces/$WS/status"
    raw
    ;;
  job)
    JID="$2"; KIND="$3"; D=$(now_deadline)
    case "$KIND" in
      marker) ARGV='["node","-e","const s=19+23;console.log(s);console.log(\"RESUME_RUNNER_42\");process.exit(s===42?0:3)"]' ;;
      bg)     ARGV='["node","-e","setTimeout(()=>{console.log(\"RESUME_BG_OK\")},2000)"]' ;;
      exit7)  ARGV='["node","-e","console.error(\"intentional\");process.exit(7)"]' ;;
      *) echo "unknown kind"; exit 2 ;;
    esac
    api POST "/v1/workspaces/$WS/jobs" "{\"jobId\":\"$JID\",\"generation\":1,\"deadlineAt\":$D,\"argv\":$ARGV,\"cwd\":\"/workspace/work\",\"maxBytes\":65536,\"timeoutMs\":60000}"
    ;;
  wait)
    api POST "/v1/jobs/$2/wait" "{\"timeoutMs\":$3}"
    raw
    ;;
  jobget)
    api GET "/v1/jobs/$2"
    raw
    ;;
  delete)
    D=$(now_deadline)
    api POST /v1/commands "{\"commandId\":\"resume-cmd-del-1\",\"workspaceId\":\"$WS\",\"generation\":1,\"action\":\"delete\",\"deadlineAt\":$D}"
    poll_command resume-cmd-del-1
    ;;
  availability)
    api GET /v1/availability; raw
    ;;
  *) echo "usage: provision|start|status|job <id> <marker|bg|exit7>|wait <id> <ms>|jobget <id>|delete|availability"; exit 2 ;;
esac
"}

## D1. Defects (each tied to a requirement)

1. **In-place mutation of the caller's array — violates R3.** `a.sort()` mutates the caller's array in place and returns the same reference. **Triggerable** on any input of length ≥2 whose default string-sort order differs from its given order, e.g. `[5,-1,3]` → array becomes `[-1,3,5]` after the call.    - Sub-note (same root cause): no numeric comparator is passed, so the sort is **lexicographic**, not numeric (`[2,10]` stays `[2,10]` because `"10" < "2"`). 4. **No-positive-integer case returns `0` or `NaN` instead of `null` — violates R2 and R4.** When nothing qualifies, `reduce(...,0)` yields `0`, then `0 / a.length`:

**Case 2 — exercises R3 (input mutation) and the `a.length` divisor (R1):**
- Input: `[5, -1, 3]`

**Case 3 — exercises non-integer / zero inclusion (R1) and again R2'd null:**
- Input: `[0, 2.5, -4]`

## D3. Fixed implementation

```js

  const positives = a.filter(x => Number.isInteger(x) && x > 0); // R1: keep only positive integers; filter does not mutate → R3 safe
```

- **Removed `a.sort()`** — it was the sole source of mutation (R3); it did not affect the sum (addition is commutative), so removing it loses nothing and eliminates the R3 violation.
- **`filter(x => Number.isInteger(x) && x > 0)`** — restricts to positive integers, excluding `0` and positive non-integers as R1 requires (`Number.isInteger` also rejects `Infinity`/`NaN`).

- **Divide by `positives.length`** — the divisor now equals the count of summed values (R1).

No in-place operation touches `a`, so R3 holds.

D1 列出 4 个缺陷：① `a.sort()` 原地修改输入（违反 R3，且默认排序是字典序、无数值比较器）；② `x >= 0` 把 `0` 与正的非整数（如 2.5）算进去（违反 R1）；③ 除以 `a.length` 而非合格元素个数（违反 R1）；④ 无正整数时返回 `0`（`a.length>0`）或 `NaN`（空数组 `0/0`）而非 `null`（违反 R2/R4）。

我对三个用例逐条手算（未执行代码，与子 Agent 一样是手推 ECMAScript 语义），全部**吻合**：

- `[-1,-2,-3]`：字典序 `"-1"<"-2"<"-3"`，数组不变 → filter `[]` → `0/3` = **`0`**；应为 **`null`** ✅
- `[5,-1,3]`：排序后 `[-1,3,5]`（调用后数组内容，R3 被破坏）→ filter `[3,5]` → `8/3` = **`2.6666666666666665`**；应为 `8/2` = **`4`** ✅

1. **不准确（推理过度）**：D1-① 称「加法可交换 ⇒ 顺序对 reduce 无关，`sort()` 只有 R3 危害」。IEEE-754 加法可交换但**不满足结合律**，重排序在极端尾数舍入场景下确实可能改变最后一位。对本题的整数输入无害，所以结论仍成立，但论证链是错的。

```js

  const positives = a.filter(x => Number.isInteger(x) && x > 0); // R1：只留正整数；filter 不改原数组 → R3 安全
  if (positives.length === 0) return null;                       // R2/R4：没有任何正整数时精确返回 null
```

{"target":"ssh","id":"15","path":"/tmp/nxr/drv.sh","content":"#!/bin/sh
# Isolated Runner resume-test driver.
# The Runner token is loaded ONLY inside this process from the 0600 env file.
# It is never echoed, never placed on the command line, and never written to output.
set -eu
umask 077

ENVF=/opt/nexus-agent-runner-test/etc/runner.env
. "$ENVF"

: "${NEXUS_AGENT_RUNNER_TOKEN:[REDACTED] token}"
: "${PORT:?missing port}"
HOST="${NEXUS_AGENT_RUNNER_HOST:-127.0.0.1}"
BASE="http://${HOST}:${PORT}"
PROTO="2026-09-13"
WS="resume-ws-42"
BODY=/tmp/nxr/.body.$$
trap 'rm -f "$BODY"' EXIT

api() { # method path [json]
  m="$1"; p="$2"
  if [ "$#" -ge 3 ]; then
    code=$(curl -sS -o "$BODY" -w '%{http_code}' -X "$m" "${BASE}${p}" \
      -H "Authorization: Bearer ${NEXUS_AGENT_RUNNER_TOKEN}" \
      -H "x-nexus-agent-protocol: ${PROTO}" \
      -H 'content-type: application/json' --data "$3")
  else
    code=$(curl -sS -o "$BODY" -w '%{http_code}' -X "$m" "${BASE}${p}" \
      -H "Authorization: Bearer ${NEXUS_AGENT_RUNNER_TOKEN}" \
      -H "x-nexus-agent-protocol: ${PROTO}")
  fi
  echo "HTTP ${code} ${m} ${p}"
  json_get status
  return 0
}

json_get() { # print one top-level-ish field value from body (string/number)
  sed -n "s/.*\"$1\":\([^,}]*\).*/\1/p" "$BODY" | head -1 | tr -d '\n'
  echo
}

raw() { cat "$BODY"; echo; }

poll_command() { # commandId
  i=0
  while [ "$i" -lt 120 ]; do
    api GET "/v1/commands/$1" >/dev/null
    st=$(sed -n 's/.*"status":"\([a-z]*\)".*/\1/p' "$BODY" | head -1)
    case "$st" in
      succeeded|failed|cancelled|unknown) echo "command $1 terminal status=$st"; raw; return 0 ;;
    esac
    i=$((i+1)); sleep 0.4
  done
  echo "command $1 did not reach terminal state"; raw; return 1
}

now_deadline() { echo $(( $(date +%s) + 900 )); }

cmd "$@" 2>/dev/null || true

case "${1:-}" in
  provision)
    D=$(now_deadline)
    api POST /v1/commands "{\"commandId\":\"resume-cmd-prov-1\",\"workspaceId\":\"$WS\",\"generation\":1,\"action\":\"provision\",\"deadlineAt\":$D,\"recipeId\":\"workspace-dev\",\"recipeRevision\":\"2\",\"runtimeDigest\":\"nexus-agent-runner:workspace-toolchain-profile-v2\",\"catalogRevision\":\"2026-09-30.2\",\"toolchain\":[{\"familyId\":\"base-tools\",\"versionId\":\"1\"}],\"runnerPlugins\":[],\"acpProfiles\":[],\"browserTarget\":null,\"retained\":false}"
    poll_command resume-cmd-prov-1
    ;;
  start)
    D=$(now_deadline)
    api POST /v1/commands "{\"commandId\":\"resume-cmd-start-1\",\"workspaceId\":\"$WS\",\"generation\":1,\"action\":\"start\",\"deadlineAt\":$D}"
    poll_command resume-cmd-start-1
    ;;
  status)
    api GET "/v1/workspaces/$WS/status"
    raw
    ;;
  job)
    JID="$2"; KIND="$3"; D=$(now_deadline)
    case "$KIND" in
      marker) ARGV='["node","-e","const s=19+23;console.log(s);console.log(\"RESUME_RUNNER_42\");process.exit(s===42?0:3)"]' ;;
      bg)     ARGV='["node","-e","setTimeout(()=>{console.log(\"RESUME_BG_OK\")},2000)"]' ;;
      exit7)  ARGV='["node","-e","console.error(\"intentional\");process.exit(7)"]' ;;
      *) echo "unknown kind"; exit 2 ;;
    esac
    api POST "/v1/workspaces/$WS/jobs" "{\"jobId\":\"$JID\",\"generation\":1,\"deadlineAt\":$D,\"argv\":$ARGV,\"cwd\":\"/workspace/work\",\"maxBytes\":65536,\"timeoutMs\":60000}"
    ;;
  wait)
    api POST "/v1/jobs/$2/wait" "{\"timeoutMs\":$3}"
    raw
    ;;
  jobget)
    api GET "/v1/jobs/$2"
    raw
    ;;
  delete)
    D=$(now_deadline)
    api POST /v1/commands "{\"commandId\":\"resume-cmd-del-1\",\"workspaceId\":\"$WS\",\"generation\":1,\"action\":\"delete\",\"deadlineAt\":$D}"
    poll_command resume-cmd-del-1
    ;;
  availability)
    api GET /v1/availability; raw
    ;;
  *) echo "usage: provision|start|status|job <id> <marker|bg|exit7>|wait <id> <ms>|jobget <id>|delete|availability"; exit 2 ;;
esac
"}
